notes.title: Portuguese-Brazil is now supported!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are updated again! 《Fury Fight》 now supports Portuguese-Brazil!
Thanks to @Savino (Flying Kick) for his great support to our localization work. He is an Youtuber who focuses on beat'em ups, if you are also a big fan of such games, follow him!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaOH4H3ejPXUvIPomLExv_Q/featured
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/5d68f3aa5bc23e2657bbfce2f2adeda66cdb8b70.png[/img]

Localization：
1.New localization support for Portuguese-Brazil;
2.Proofread and optimized the text of the English version;
